justification: Inspected javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typeinference/bounds/SubtypeOfBound.java, BoundSet.java, TypeSubtypeOfType.java, TypeInference.java, and javaparser-symbol-solver-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/resolution/typeinference/bounds/SubtypeOfBoundTest.java. Repository-wide search found only 5 files referencing SubtypeOfBound: 3 production files (BoundSet, TypeSubtypeOfType, TypeInference) plus 1 test file, alongside the class itself. The class is a small bound value object with two ResolvedType fields and limited outgoing dependencies (ResolvedType, InferenceVariable, ProperUpperBound/ProperLowerBound, TypeHelper, collections), so it does not show the high fan-in/high fan-out pattern expected for hub-like modularization.
